title: This merge proposal will fix an issue where fwupd is unable to write firmware updates on TPM FDE systems when only the default image is provided.
description:
This merge proposal will fix an issue where fwupd is unable to write firmware updates on TPM FDE systems when only the default image is provided. 

PPA: https://launchpad.net/~bamf0/+archive/ubuntu/fwupd-lp2147129-fail-to-notify-snapd
